title: The Snowman
author: Jo Nesbø
summary: As the first snow falls on Oslo, women begin to disappear, each leaving behind a snowman. Troubled detective Harry Hole realises the killings reach back years and he may be the one being watched.
readIf: you like Scandinavian crime fiction with a damaged detective and a cold, wintry mood.
skipIf: you dislike graphic crime scenes or serial-killer plots.

pairings.reason: Another dark Nordic thriller with a long-buried crime and an outsider investigating.
The classic serial-killer hunt with a sharper psychological edge.
A fast forensic chase with a killer who leaves clues behind.
